# skardi-notion-measure-page

Skardi ingests SaaS content into a per-workspace corpus so an agent can answer questions over it.

This page is the Notion ETL measurement corpus. It exists to prove that page text — rendered as Markdown, not block structure — reaches the corpus database.

- `block_children` carries a block's payload under a key named by its own type, which a fixed relational mapping cannot address.
- `retrieve_page_markdown` returns the whole page rendered in one call, which is the shape an OKF document row wants.

If you are reading this row in Postgres, the pipeline worked end to end.
